Name: White Water Terrace
Author: Ciriun
Description:
My personal edit of Meevers' White Water Farm map ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1293]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1293[/url]) made available with permission.

White Water Terrace is a large, open terrace style farm with a natural river to the north and a canal to the south. There are multiple waterfalls including one that goes under the ground and comes out of the southern cliff wall! The whole map was designed to be a balance between efficiency and aesthetics without compromising too much on either.

There are two variants controlled by the config file, one with palm trees to the east above the river, and one for anyone who finds that too cheaty, it doesn't fit their story/aesthetic, whatever reason. If you want another variant feel free to request but I don't guarantee it will happen.

Please note that this mod also edits the Forest map to correct the warps, so it will conflict with any mods that also use that map.

Manifest.Description: An expanded terrace style grassy farm with plenty of space to farm and decorate.
